description:
Desktop widget for Claude, Codex, Antigravity and Grok usage limits and reset times.

QuotaDock is an always-on-top Windows widget for Claude, OpenAI Codex,
Google Antigravity (Gemini), and Grok usage limits and reset times.
View multiple Claude and Codex accounts with separate names and colours.

Each Codex account can use CLI login or separate browser sign-in.
Only one account at a time uses the shared CLI login; browser sign-in
accounts keep credentials separate. Usage checks do not send model
prompts, extract browser cookies, or send telemetry.

Normal, compact, and nano layouts share account settings. Twelve display
languages follow Windows or can be chosen in Settings.
